query: SELECT airlines.Airline FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.uid = flights.air WHERE flights.SourceAirport = "APG" INTERSECT SELECT airlines.Airline FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.uid = flights.air WHERE flights.SourceAirport = "CVO"

question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 5 and have at least 2 friends.
gold_sql: SELECT Highschooler.name FROM Friend JOIN Highschooler ON Friend.student_id = Highschooler.ID WHERE Highschooler.gr > 5 GROUP BY Friend.student_id HAVING count(*) >= 2
query: SELECT Highschooler.name FROM Friend JOIN Highschooler ON Friend.student_id = Highschooler.ID WHERE Highschooler.gr > 5 GROUP BY Friend.student_id HAVING count(*) >= 2

question: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?
